reference_drag_baseline.note: Calibrated to latest accessible H2AIR results at 20 m/s: 18.905 N total drag, 2.039 N induced, 8.830 N stopped-random lift-prop drag.

lift_prop_cruise_state_factors.note: folded=0.05, stopped_aligned=0.15, stopped_random=0.50, windmilling=1.00 projected-area factors; replace with CFD/wind-tunnel/flight data.

lift_propulsion_hardware.note: Current 18x6/55 N/1600 W lift combination is retained only for a fail/pass comparison. No flight hardware selection is made from it.

pusher_generic_prop_map.note: Generic Ct/Cp vs J map is for operating-point screening only; use manufacturer or thrust-stand maps for design release.

cruise_propulsive_efficiency_reference.note: Used only to preserve current aircraft-model electrical cruise power.

wing_area_scaling.note: Stall speed scales from the source model's 14.75 m/s baseline. Wing-profile drag scales with qS and total calibrated induced drag is treated as wing-dominated for sensitivity. Re-close with live aero/tail/structure model before geometry freeze.

15kg_peak_power.note: Uses the current model thrust margin, vertical acceleration, climb speed, effective lift efficiency and power margin. Actual motor/ESC/battery thermal/current pass remains open.
